aggregation_rules.advisory_rule: non-blocking issues, suggestions, cautions, and implementation notes are placed in advisory follow-ups
aggregation_rules.blocking_rule: only selected reviewer blocking_issues and blocking-severity issues are placed in blocking fields
aggregation_rules.duplicates: ignored after stable unique absolute-path selection
aggregation_rules.pass_rule: all selected reviewers must approve and blocker_count must be zero
aggregation_rules.score_normalization: scores greater than10 divided by10; scores already on0-10 scale retained

reviewers.scope: GraphQL, MCP, JSON Schema, mutation contracts, metrics/readback contract compatibility, API fixture parity
SwiftUI/AppKit architecture, SwiftData containment, lifecycle window ownership, projection publication, app delegate launch ordering
Native macOS windowing, menus, keyboard behavior, pasteboard/export behavior, accessibility, operator interaction patterns
Cancellation, shutdown, recovery, late-output overflow, leases, rollout hard-limit hold conditions, durable idempotency
SwiftUI visual state contract, disabled and pending states, empty/loading states, popovers, focus, spinner alignment
